extension.summary: Bossanova808 mod of Confluence skin, originally by Jezz_X & Team Kodi. Various tidy-ups and visual tweaks, OzWeather and ClearArt support built in.
extension.description: Bossanova808 mod of Confluence skin, originally by Jezz_X & Team Kodi. Various tidy-ups and visual tweaks, OzWeather and ClearArt support built in.
extension.news:
v5.0.930 - Cross-reference the whole skin against upstream Confluence and against Piers; standardise all mod comment markers to one consistent format and label previously-unmarked code (PPI/codec-logo overlays, Recently Played, Adults-profile TV menus, etc.) - Refresh strings.po from upstream, and protect the custom PPI/codec-logo settings string block from being overwritten by future refreshes - Remove unused debug-only scaffolding left over from earlier ClearArt development
v5.0.928 - Fix fast profile switching not working for the "Adults HDD"/"Kids HDD" profiles - fell back to a full logout instead - Remove unused "- Away" profile switching entries
v5.0.927 - Add comprehensive PlayerProcessInfo (PPI) dialog: detailed video/audio/system info, plus Dolby Vision metadata and Amlogic processing details on p3i/AM6B+ hardware - Add codec/HDR/Dolby Vision badge overlays on video start, in the OSD, and in the PlayerProcessInfo dialog - Add graceful fallback to real Kodi values (or a clean "N/A") for PPI info fields on Windows/non-Amlogic platforms, instead of blank or garbled text - Fix codec badges never actually appearing on screen - the file defining them was never registered with the skin engine - Fix ClearArt/thumbnail overlapping the PlayerProcessInfo dialog - Add "p3i Extras" section to skin settings: codec logo duration (numeric entry, default 3s) and position (Left/Center/Right, default Top Left) for startup/OSD/PPI badges
